nodes.label: Model Serving Factory / Control Plane
nodes.rationale: Turns local and remote inference runtimes (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, remote OpenAI-compatible) into one operational workflow with a content-addressed registry, resource planning, and a persistent deployment supervisor.

nodes.label: Schema-constrained Extraction
nodes.rationale: JSON Schema / Pydantic first, no free-form JSON guessing. Preferred over a monolithic VLM because CPU-only production needs predictable failure modes; OCR + constrained extraction + validation is easier to audit and benchmark than a black-box raw-image pipeline.

nodes.label: OCR/Layout Backends
nodes.rationale: pdf_text, tesseract, and paddleocr behind one interface; produces OCR blocks with evidence ids and bounding boxes that the extractor must cite per field.

nodes.label: Multi-stage Extraction Router
nodes.rationale: ExtractionRouter wraps ExtractionService stages under a Pydantic RoutingPolicy; rules accept/fallback/escalate/fail and record a routing audit for reproducibility and metrics.

nodes.label: Reproducible Dataset & Run Governance
nodes.rationale: Immutable dataset hashes covering rows plus document SHA-256, plus per-run manifests with git state and hashes, enable integrity verification, resumable runs, and drift refusal.

nodes.label: Judge Calibration Gate
nodes.rationale: An uncalibrated LLM judge may only warn, never block a release. Judge budgets can fail only after a judge<->human calibration set clears >=30 real pairs, MAE within threshold, and correlation >=0.3 per dimension; the gate fails closed.

nodes.label: Hallucination Rate by Ingestion Path
nodes.rationale: hallucination_rate is grounded against consumed OCR text. Vision profiles consume page images (no consumed text), so their near-1.0 value is a grounding artifact, not model hallucination; segment by ingestion_path before comparing.

nodes.label: Vision Extraction Path
nodes.rationale: vision:true bypasses OCR: images normalized to PNG, PDF pages rasterized with PyMuPDF, sent as OpenAI image_url blocks; .txt rejected. Artifacts label results vision or ocr:<backend> to compare both paths on one manifest.

nodes.label: Human Review Workflow
nodes.rationale: Invalid/low-confidence/weakly-grounded extractions auto-enter a review queue with expiring leases, optimistic version checks (HTTP 409), immutable history, and train-split-only exports to prevent label leakage into evaluation.
